title: Master Itinerary
intro: Approximate dates: Friday July 24 – Thursday August 6, 2026

parts.subtitle: Day-by-Day Schedule (Part 1)
parts.next_segment: Next Segments: Kamakura, Tsukiji & Japanese Alps (Part 2)

days.title: Day 1 — Arrival (Soft)

schedule.activity: Land NRT or HND; VJW QR immigration/customs; train to hotel
Check-in; buy/load Suica; konbini lunch; short neighborhood walk
Early ramen or gyudon; bed by 21:00 (jet lag)

days.wow_moment: First night skyline — Sumida River or Tokyo Station Marunouchi facades

days.title: Day 2 — Ueno Nature + Asakusa

schedule.activity: Ueno Park — Shinobazu Pond lotus; optional Tokyo National Museum
Sensō-ji outer grounds; Kappabashi kitchen street
Hoppy Street izakaya or Ameyoko market grazing

days.wow_moment: Lotus pond reflection at Shinobazu before crowds
days.rainy_day: Full museum day + covered Nakamise arcade

days.title: Day 3 — Meiji Forest + Shinjuku

schedule.activity: Meiji Jingu forest approach — shaded, quiet
Yoyogi Park edges; Omotesando backstreets
Omoide Yokocho or Golden Gai (early)

days.wow_moment: Torii tunnel at Meiji in morning mist after rain
days.low_energy: Meiji only; afternoon café and hotel bath
days.rainy_day: Teien Art Museum or teamLab Planets (book ahead)

days.title: Day 4 — Kamakura Coast

schedule.activity: JR to Kamakura — Daibutsu (Great Buddha) wooded approach
Enoshima or Hase coastal walk; Enoden line scenery
Return Tokyo; simple dinner near hotel

days.wow_moment: Enoden coastal tram view with Fuji on clear days
days.low_energy: Kamakura town + Buddha only; skip Enoshima climb

days.title: Day 5 — Tokyo: Market & Imperial

schedule.activity: Tsukiji Outer Market — sushi breakfast, tamagoyaki
Imperial Palace East Gardens (shaded history)
Pack/prep — takkyubin to Kyoto if sending luggage

days.wow_moment: Sashimi breakfast standing at Tsukiji counter
days.rainy_day: Depachika Tokyo Station + Japan Food Town indoor

days.title: Day 6 — Transit + Takayama

schedule.activity: Shinkansen Tokyo → Nagoya + Hida Limited Express; activate JR Pass
Sanmachi Suji preserved merchant streets
Hida beef dinner (reserve) — splurge night

days.low_energy: Hotel onsen/rest only after rail day
days.rainy_day: Sake brewery tastings + Hida Folk Village

days.title: Day 7 — Shirakawa-go

schedule.activity: Highway bus to Shirakawa-go gassho-zukuri village
Return Takayama; Miyagawa Morning Market or riverside walk
Light soba or hotel kaiseki-lite; early sleep

days.wow_moment: Ogimachi viewpoint over thatched roofs before 10:00 crowds
days.low_energy: Takayama market + onsen only; skip Shirakawa-go

days.title: Day 8 — Transit + Nishiki

schedule.activity: Hida Express → Nagoya → Shinkansen Kyoto; receive forwarded luggage
Nishiki Market covered food arcade; Pontocho stroll
Casual izakaya near Kawaramachi; early night

days.wow_moment: First Kyoto canal glimpse at twilight near Pontocho
days.rainy_day: Nishiki fully covered; Kyoto Railway Museum

days.title: Day 9 — Fushimi Inari + Sake

schedule.activity: Fushimi Inari — torii tunnel to first overlook
Fushimi sake district — Gekkeikan Okura Museum
Gion backstreets at distance; Pontocho or Nishijin soba

days.wow_moment: Empty torii corridor in early light
days.low_energy: Fushimi base only; return hotel by 11:00
days.rainy_day: Inari with umbrella; afternoon indoor sake museum

days.title: Day 10 — Arashiyama Bamboo

schedule.activity: Bamboo grove then Tenryu-ji garden (shade)
Hozu River walk or Katsura cycle paths
Obanzai dinner at Warajiya (reserve)

days.wow_moment: Bamboo grove when still quiet; river mountain backdrop
days.low_energy: Tenryu-ji garden only; tram back to central Kyoto
days.rainy_day: Sagano Romantic Train or Manga Museum + café

days.title: Day 11 — Higashiyama Dawn

schedule.activity: Kiyomizu-dera early entry; Ninenzaka/Sannenzaka descent
Philosopher's Path → Ginkaku-ji (Silver Pavilion)
Pack for Osaka; yudofu or tofu kaiseki

days.wow_moment: Kiyomizu stage view over Kyoto basin in morning air
days.low_energy: Philosopher's Path flat walk only; skip Kiyomizu climb
days.rainy_day: Nanzen-ji covered corridors + Kyoto National Museum

days.title: Day 12 — Transit + Dotonbori

schedule.activity: JR Kyoto → Osaka (~30 min); hotel drop bags
Kuromon Ichiba Market — takoyaki, kushikatsu samples
Dotonbori neon food crawl — okonomiyaki, gyoza alley

days.wow_moment: Glico sign reflection on canal after dark
days.rainy_day: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan or Umeda Sky Building

days.title: Day 13 — Castle + Namba

schedule.activity: Osaka Castle Park grounds and moat walk (exterior)
Namba Yasaka Shrine; Amerikamura café; Shinsekai kushikatsu
Final splurge kushikatsu or yakiniku; confirm KIX transfer

days.wow_moment: Castle ramparts view from Nishinomaru Garden
days.low_energy: Namba neighborhood food only; skip castle
days.rainy_day: TeamLab Osaka or Kaiyukan full afternoon

days.title: Day 14 — Departure

schedule.activity: Checkout; carry-on only or luggage already forwarded
Nankai Rapi:t or Haruka to KIX — allow 2.5–3 hrs pre-flight
Flight KIX → US (open-jaw completion)

days.wow_moment: Last convenience-store onigiri at gate — trip bookend
days.low_energy: Airport lounge if access; minimal morning activity
